content: Sanity i18n pitfalls: (1) over-fetching — GROQ without language filter returns all locales; must use title[language == 'en'][0].value not title; (2) field-level vs document-level strategy is irreversible at scale — choose upfront; field-level requires simultaneous publish in all languages (workflow mismatch risk), document-level allows independent publishing; (3) hardcoded language lists break when adding a third locale — use async dynamic language loading; (4) plugin v4→v5 migration — internationalized-array moved language id from _key to language field, silently breaking existing GROQ queries; (5) incomplete translations cause silent null returns — always use coalesce() with fallback.
